yamlShown:
apiVersion: phenix.sandia.gov/v1
kind: Topology
metadata:
  name: FIXME
spec:
  nodes:
    - type: Router
      general:
        hostname: router-device-0
      hardware:
        vcpus: '1'
        memory: '2048'
        os_type: linux
        drives:
          - image: vyos.qc2
      network:
        interfaces:
          - vlan: users
            name: eth0
            type: ethernet
            proto: dhcp
          - vlan: b
            name: eth1
            type: ethernet
            proto: dhcp
    - type: Firewall
      general:
        hostname: firewall-device-1
      hardware:
        vcpus: '1'
        memory: '2048'
        os_type: linux
        drives:
          - image: ubuntu.qc2
      network:
        interfaces:
          - vlan: b
            name: eth0
            type: ethernet
            proto: dhcp
    - type: VirtualMachine
      general:
        hostname: client-1
      hardware:
        vcpus: '1'
        memory: '2048'
        os_type: linux
        drives:
          - image: ubuntu.qc2
      network:
        interfaces:
          - vlan: users
            name: eth0
            type: ethernet
            proto: static
            address: 10.10.10.10
            mask: 24
            gateway: 10.10.10.1
      annotations:
        owner: ops
      labels:
        zone: corp
      injections:
        - src: /phenix/injects/a.sh
          dst: /tmp/a.sh
          description: x
    - type: VirtualMachine
      general:
        hostname: server-device-4
      hardware:
        vcpus: '1'
        memory: '2048'
        os_type: linux
        drives:
          - image: ubuntu.qc2
      network:
        interfaces:
          - vlan: users
            name: eth0
            type: ethernet
            proto: dhcp
    - external: true
      type: HIL
      general:
        hostname: server-device-5
      network:
        interfaces:
          - vlan: users
            name: eth0
